learn_source: Watch the blacksmith quench a glowing piece at the bench in the Town scene — the Lantern Arch centerpiece demands metal hardened true, not just cooled
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on something hot from the forge once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the hardening runs even to the core with no warp; at baseline the surface hardens true but thick pieces may cool with a slight bow. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: State-dependent: glowing hot, it hardens evenly with a hiss and holds its shape; already cold, no_effect — there is no heat to set
The crust sets hard and glassy — the loaf survives but eats like a brick
The heat sets and evens as it cools — the stone hardens into a piece cool enough to handle
No physical effect — the cast passes over the animal without attaching

receivers.reaction_kind: amused shrug, returns to work without breaking his hum
